This normalizes nuclear cover for conventional and geopolitical coercion.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.1","1B.2","1B.3"]},{"title":"Answers by Vladimir Putin and Alexander Lukashenko to media questions","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74002","summary":"Putin said a tactical nuclear drill was “not about using these weapons” and was “just routine work.” This is the closest restraint-flavored evidence I found, but it was said during a live nuclear exercise in Belarus, so it is weak counterevidence.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.2","1B.1"]}]}
